qa: App Fusion is possible with the following combinations. ●[Hackmon] with [Protecmon] link card ●[Hackmon] with [Pipomon] link card ●[Protecmon] with [Hackmon] link card ●[Protecmon] with [Pipomon] link card ●[Pipomon] with [Hackmon] link card ●[Pipomon] with [Protecmon] link card
extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [App Fusion] [Hackmon] & [Protecmon] & [Pipomon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Hackmon] & [Protecmon] & [Pipomon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon with the [System], [Life] or [Transmutation] trait gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 3 [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
